items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (`_filter_sliced_prefetch_queryset`, `partition_by`, `low_mark`/`high_mark`). The helper has a docstring explaining the ROW_NUMBER() emulation, and formatting matches the surrounding Django code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One short helper is shared by the reverse-FK, M2M and generic-relation paths and is built from ORM pieces (Window, RowNumber, lookups, clear_limits, get_order_by). No duplication or debug leftovers. Minor nit: contenttypes imports a private helper from another module.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Adds an explicit `NotSupportedError` when the backend lacks `supports_over_clause`, uses `DEFAULT_DB_ALIAS` as the fallback alias, and handles `high_mark is None`. No exceptions are swallowed and there are no magic constants.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: Uses `Window(RowNumber(), partition_by=partition_by, order_by=order_by)` with a GreaterThan(low_mark) filter, plus LessThanOrEqual only `if high_mark is not None`. `clear_limits()` is called on the copy made by `.using()`, so the user's queryset is not mutated. Hidden tests pass.
